#### `stc.relics.yubikey.enable`

Whether to enable YubiKey user tools (manager, touch detector, OATH app).

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `false`
- **Example:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/home/yubikey.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/home/yubikey.nix)
